description: Align Customer handler contracts with the repository interfaces and retain the two already-applied reported compile fixes.
steps: Remove the duplicate repository, audit, read, unit-of-work, and transaction interfaces from Finnova.Service/Customers/CustomerPorts.cs; keep only service-owned application ports in CustomerApplicationPorts.cs.

Update CreateCustomerCommand.cs, ModifyCustomerCommand.cs, QueryCustomer.cs, and CustomerChildCommandHandler.cs to import Finnova.Repository.Interfaces so handlers consume the interfaces implemented by CustomerRepository, CustomerAuditRepository, CustomerReadRepository, and CustomerUnitOfWork.

Preserve CustomerChildCommandHandler.Handle(ClearDefaultBankAccountCommand, CancellationToken) as async Task and preserve InMemoryNationalityRepository.GetActiveByCodeAsync with active, trimmed, case-insensitive, cloned results.
acceptance_criteria: The service handlers and repository implementations reference one Customer repository contract family.
The clear-default MediatR handler has the required Task return type.
The in-memory nationality fake implements the active-by-code contract with production-equivalent semantics.
findings: Static inspection found the two reported fixes already present in the worktree. Do not revert them. The duplicate CustomerPorts contract is the remaining contract-boundary defect.
